cause_quote: The new Gateway artifact downloader set `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(600000)`, which aborted any request still transferring after ten minutes.
user_saw: A cold Crabbox worker dispatch over a slow Gateway uplink timed out before the worker enrolled.
summary: The fix sized enrollment deadlines and transfer grants from the combined artifact bytes and replaced fixed HTTP attempt deadlines with a two-minute socket inactivity timeout.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff: #133037 replaced package-based setup with a Gateway-served runtime download, gave the request and its transfer grant ten-minute limits, and put the new download inside the existing fifteen-minute enrollment command. Later fixes added retries, resume, and a longer transfer grant, which exposed the command deadline in the reported run. Slow transfers that needed more than the fixed budgets had been unsupported since this download path shipped.
